recipe.visualDefinition: An illustrative travel poster depicting a bird's-eye view of a historical brick building with a golden roof, situated on a cobblestone street by a body of water with sailboats. The scene is rendered with a distinct vintage, hand-painted aesthetic, featuring strong shadows and a warm color palette, promoting Nantucket as a destination.
coreVisualRelationships: The prominent brick building acts as the central architectural anchor, defining the historical character of the scene.
The cobblestone street and water with sailboats provide environmental context, suggesting a coastal, old-world setting.
The strong diagonal lines of the building and street guide the eye from the upper left to the lower right, creating depth.
The large, bold text at the bottom firmly grounds the promotional message within the visual narrative.
The interplay of light and shadow emphasizes texture and form, particularly on the cobblestones and building facade.
coreInvariants: A prominent, multi-story brick building with white-framed windows and a distinct golden-orange roof.
A textured cobblestone ground plane that transitions from light to shadow.
A body of water with small, colorful sailboats, positioned in the upper left quadrant.
A horse-drawn carriage and a group of people near the building, providing human and historical scale.
A large, sans-serif typeface for 'NANTUCKET' and a smaller, complementary typeface for 'THE NEW HAVEN RAILROAD' at the bottom.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main building occupies the central-right portion of the image, appearing large and imposing from a high-angle perspective. The text at the bottom is significantly scaled to dominate the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brick building serves as the primary visual anchor due to its size, central placement, and detailed rendering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the upper left (water and sailboats) down along the building's edge and the cobblestone street to the lower right, where the horse and carriage are, before settling on the large text at the bottom. The strong diagonal of the street creates a dynamic flow.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white background on the left and bottom acts as negative space, framing the detailed illustration and making the dark text stand out. The dark mass of the tree also creates a pocket of negative space against the lighter sky/water.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and oranges (brick, roof, cobblestones) establish a historical, inviting, and earthy tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and greens (water, trees) provide a natural contrast to the warm tones, suggesting an outdoor, natural setting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellows, oranges, and reds (sailboats, highlights on roof and cobblestones) add pops of color and visual interest, drawing attention to specific details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Colors are generally desaturated in the shadows and more vibrant in the illuminated areas, creating a strong sense of depth and light. The overall value range is broad, from deep shadows to bright highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid overly bright or neon colors that would detract from the vintage aesthetic.
Maintain a warm, earthy base palette.
Limit the number of distinct accent colors to maintain visual harmony.

adjustableVariables: The specific architectural details of the building (e.g., number of windows, roof style).
The type and number of vessels on the water.
The style and period of the horse-drawn carriage.
The time of day suggested by the lighting and shadow placement.
The specific font and layout of the promotional text.
mustRedesign: The specific year '1772' on the building facade, if a different historical period is desired.
The exact number and configuration of people depicted near the building.

mustAchieve: A clear sense of historical charm and coastal atmosphere.
A hand-painted, illustrative quality with visible brushstrokes or texture.
A strong contrast between light and shadow to define forms.
A cohesive color palette that evokes a vintage feel.
Legible and impactful typography for the destination and sponsor.
avoid: Photorealistic rendering that loses the illustrative quality.
Flat, untextured surfaces that lack depth.
Muted or dull colors that lack vibrancy in highlights.

postGenerationChecks: Does the building appear historically appropriate for Nantucket?
Are the cobblestones and water textured convincingly?
Is the overall mood evocative of a vintage travel poster?
Is the text clearly readable and well-integrated?
Are the shadows consistent with a single light source?
Does the composition effectively guide the viewer's eye?
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate a high-angle, illustrative scene of a historical coastal town. Feature a prominent, multi-story brick building with a distinct roof, situated on a textured cobblestone street. Include a body of water with small, colorful sailboats in the background. Employ strong directional lighting to create deep shadows and bright highlights, enhancing texture and depth. Use a warm, earthy color palette with contrasting blues/greens and limited, vibrant accents. Integrate large, bold, vintage-style typography for the location and a smaller, complementary font for the sponsor at the bottom, framed by the illustration.

letterConstructionRules: Main title: Blocky, condensed sans-serif with thick, uniform strokes.
Main title: 'N' and 'K' have extended horizontal strokes at the top and bottom, creating a distinctive, almost slab-like appearance.
Main title: 'A' has a flat top.
Main title: 'T' has a wide top bar.
Main title: 'U' has a flat bottom.
Subtitle: Wider, slightly less condensed sans-serif, also with uniform strokes but thinner than the main title.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title: 'N' and 'K' feature prominent horizontal extensions.
Main title: 'A' has a flat apex.
Main title: 'T' has a very wide crossbar.

composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into a dark, organic shape that serves as a background for the text, contrasting with the lighter cobblestone texture above
integrated into the same dark, organic shape as the main title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: hierarchical contrast in size and weight within a consistent sans-serif style, both set in white on a dark background
graphicDevices: Organic, dark, blob-like shape serving as a background panel for the text, contrasting with the textured illustration above.

preserve: All-caps for both display and subtitle.
Condensed, heavy sans-serif for display text.
Slightly wider, medium weight sans-serif for subtitle.
White text on a dark, irregular background shape.
The distinctive horizontal extensions on 'N' and 'K' for the display text.
avoid: Light or thin weights for display text.
Text directly on the textured illustration without a background panel.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides a similar condensed, heavy, blocky sans-serif feel with tight tracking, suitable for display.
Offers a tall, condensed, all-caps sans-serif aesthetic, though it might require manual adjustment for the unique 'N' and 'K' features.
A strong, condensed sans-serif that could capture the display text's impact, but also needs custom modification for specific character forms.
A good option for the subtitle due to its clear, slightly condensed sans-serif form, and could be adapted for the display with significant modification.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Render the full illustration including the building, water, trees, cobblestone ground, and the organic dark shape at the bottom, but without any text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title text 'NANTUCKET' in a condensed, heavy, all-caps sans-serif font with tight tracking, in white, positioned within the upper part of the dark organic shape. Below it, overlay the subtitle text 'THE NEW HAVEN RAILROAD' in a slightly wider, medium-weight, all-caps sans-serif font, also in white, with normal tracking, positioned within the lower part of the dark organic shape. Ensure the unique character forms of 'N' and 'K' in the main title are replicated, either through custom vector paths or a highly modifiable font.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text condensed, heavy, and all-caps?
Does the main title text have tight tracking?
Are the 'N' and 'K' in the main title distinctively extended horizontally?
Is the subtitle text a slightly wider, medium-weight, all-caps sans-serif?
Is all text white on a dark, irregular background shape?
Is the text positioned at the bottom of the composition, integrated with the background shape?
